input_messages.content: Hi! I have a flight coming up from Boston to Minneapolis, and I’d like to make a couple of changes to my reservation. Could you help me with that?
Sure! My user ID is chen_lee_6825 and the reservation ID is YAX4DR.
I’d like to upgrade the class for all passengers on the reservation to business class. Also, I want to add two checked bags under my name, and I have Gold membership.

Yes, please proceed with upgrading both passengers to business class on both flights and add two checked bags under my name. And yes, you can use my credit card ending in 4938634 for any charges. However, I’d like to know the total cost for the upgrade before finalizing, as I have a budget of up to $650 for the business class upgrade. Could you let me know the total fee before confirming?

Since the total cost is over my budget, could you check how much it would be to upgrade just one passenger—my companion Noah—to business class instead, while still adding the two checked bags under my name? Let me know if that would fit within my $650 budget.

That’s a bit over my budget. Is there any way to reduce the cost, maybe by only upgrading Noah on one of the two flights, or by applying any Gold member discounts? If not, please let me know the cost to upgrade Noah to business class on just the first flight, HAT235, and keep everything else the same.

Yes, that works for me. Please go ahead and upgrade Noah to business class on HAT235, keep the rest as is, and add the two checked bags under my name. You can use my credit card ending in 4938634 for the charges. Thank you!
Yes, I confirm. Please proceed with these changes. Thank you!
Thank you for your help! That’s all I needed. Have a great day! ###STOP###
